title: ID0409335-DC/Si-D/DK[PEtcz3] - Charger in FailsafeMode after FW attempt
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
After a not successful FW update the charger is in
FailsafeMode
Solution:
Change APN from cu.siemens.global to emobility.siemens
2025-02-27 Note from L2:
After the update, Router 1 APN was incorrect and didn't connect to SCB.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0409335-DC/Si-D/DK[PEtcz3] - Charger in FailsafeMode after FW attempt CRM:00315002399
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco
We had a technician at the site this morning.
The APN setting in the router was not set correct.
After this was changed the router came back online and has now been updated to the latest FW.
You can close the case. Thanks.
